facts.business: Jubilant FoodWorks Limited operates quick-service restaurant chains including Domino's Pizza and Dunkin' Donuts in India and international markets through subsidiaries.
key_risks: Impairment of investments in subsidiaries due to uncertain future cash flows and discount rate assumptions
Goodwill and intangible asset impairment sensitivity to revenue growth and discount rate changes
facts.related_party_note: JFL Employees Welfare Trust included in standalone financial statements; transactions with subsidiaries Jubilant FoodWorks Lanka (Private) Limited, Jubilant FoodWorks Bangladesh Limited, Jubilant FoodWorks Netherlands B.V., and Jubilant FoodWorks International Investments Limited.
